Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical handbook page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The yearly car-and-truck crash figure is printed without a source or year; it is taught only as the handbook's figure, not as a current statistic [A01].
The cyclist-passing distance and the bike-lane yield rule repeat rules already taught in sections five and six; they are not restated here to avoid duplicate facts [A04].
The blind-pedestrian right-of-way statute repeats a rule taught in the right-of-way section; only the new driver tips from this page are taught here [A06].
The moped page points to the DMV website for engine-size detail; that detail was not consulted and is not asserted.
